Drug Discovery Chemistry is now accepting speaker proposals for the premier event dedicated to medicinal, biophysical, and computational chemists working across pharma, biotech, and academia. Focused on the discovery and optimization challenges of small-molecule and macrocyclic drug candidates, the 27th Annual conference explores the critical "middle space" of drug discovery—from hit identification and lead optimization to emerging modalities, AI-enabled design, and translational strategies. Join a community of discovery scientists and share the innovations shaping the next generation of medicines. Matthew D. Disney, PhD Institute Professor & Chair, UF Scripps Institute for Biomedical Innovation & Technology "Really the top conference for drug discovery in my view. The most interesting tracks and talks in the field." "Drug Discovery Chemistry is a must attend event. It consistently has great speakers and attendees!" "The coverage of fascinating topics and the combination of industry and academic participants make this my favorite conference of the year!"
